verdict.rationale: Xero's marketing pages document JAX, a built-in AI finance partner. Users can delegate bank reconciliation to it (categorizing and matching transactions) and can create, edit and send invoices with plain-language commands. A natural-language Q&A on cash flow and profit is also described. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on JAX's scope, permissions and approval controls; evidence of delegation beyond invoicing and reconciliation; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: JAX, your AI finance partner, reconciles your transactions for you.
JAX is Xero's AI invoicing tool that lets you create, edit, and send invoices using plain-language commands.
Get instant answers about your cash flow, profit trends and financial health.
